title: 第9章 谁干的第10章 我干的
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
嗯昂！嗯昂！嗯昂！
被关着的公驴这个时候叫唤起来，它似乎也饿了，想要吃早餐。
李大炮也不小气，扔了两根大黄瓜给它，给它也开开胃。
“大炮。”
叶秋玲的声音传来，她也来了，同样也是来照顾李大炮，给他送点吃的。
“秋玲。”
李大炮立即双眼放光，要不是叶秋玲，他也不可能得到李家老祖的传承，必须得好好感谢她。
“大炮，饿了吧，你不是说我做的馒头好吃吗？我给你带了几个过来，还是热乎的。”
叶秋玲说道，她从怀里掏出几个大白馒头，都还冒着热气，还有她的香气。
“秋玲，你真好。”
李大炮有些感动，叶秋玲刚刚嫁到他们村的时候，他就有些朝思暮想。
如今能够心想事成，发展到这一步，他只感觉跟做梦一样。
“傻小子，我不对你好，谁对你好。”
叶秋玲笑道，成为了李大炮的女人，对他的态度明显发生了巨大的变化。
“嗯哼！”
孟晚晴在旁边出声打扰，她觉得要是再不阻止一下，只怕这两人当着她的面，就敢胡作非为。
她有些惊讶，没想到牛犊子村，竟然还有一个这么俊俏的女人。
也就是没打扮。
如果打扮打扮的话，都不会比她逊色。
“啊？大炮，你家有女人？”

叶秋玲这才发现了孟晚晴，同样被她的姿色给惊艳到了，随后内心都有一种吃醋的感觉。
“你好，我是牛犊子村新来的村支书，暂时没有落脚地，所以在李大炮同志家里暂住一下。”孟晚晴又一次解释。
“这样啊，我，我还有事，我先走了。”
叶秋玲连忙告辞，生怕被别人看出点什么。
“秋玲做的馒头，王姨煮的鸡蛋。”
李大炮只感觉人生达到了巅峰，能够和曹孟德一较高下。
“李大炮，你们村的人民风还真是淳朴，又是送鸡蛋又是送馒头的，等一下不会还有人来给你送牛奶吧？”
孟晚晴开口啐道，她感觉李大炮和叶秋玲肯定也有一腿，绝对有不为人知的秘密。
“哎呦，孟小姐，你说对了，我在村里那可是玉面小郎君，给我送吃的多了去了。”
李大炮开口忽悠，他可没有开玩笑，没过一会儿，又一位大娘过来给他送吃的。
孟晚晴这次没有怀疑，因为眼前的大娘年纪很大，牙齿都掉了两颗，总不能怀疑他们之间还有一腿。
“大炮，出息了，找媳妇了。
“大娘，你别误会，我不是他媳妇。”
“明白明白，现在年轻人都喜欢叫女朋友。”
大娘摆出一副我懂的样子，随后立即告辞，不影响他们小两口谈情说爱。
孟晚晴坐不住了，随后带着李大炮立即出门，她要召集全村的人过来进行宣布，省得来一个人就要解释一次。
“大炮，你帮我喊一下，把村里的人全都喊过来。”
孟晚晴说道，她现在也算是看清楚了村子的大致样子。
牛犊子村村名很响亮，但村子并不大，房子全都很破旧，一看就很穷，很落后。
李大炮非常配合，扯着嗓子就喊了起来：“大家过来开会了，还在炕上搂着自己媳妇，或者搂着别人媳妇舍不得起来的，开完会了再回去继续躺着。”

村子不大，他这一嗓子，把在村子的村民都喊了过来。
content_en:
Uh-huh! Uh-huh! Uh-huh!
The imprisoned male donkey started braying at this time. It seemed to be hungry and wanted to have breakfast.
Li Dapao was not stingy and threw two big cucumbers to it to appetize it.
"Cannon."
Ye Qiuling's voice came, and she came too. She also came to take care of Li Dapao and bring him some food.
"Qiu Ling."
Li Dapao's eyes immediately shone. If it weren't for Ye Qiuling, he wouldn't have been able to obtain the inheritance from the ancestor of the Li family. He must thank her.
"Dapao, are you hungry? Didn't you say that the steamed buns I made are delicious? I brought some for you, and they are still warm."
Ye Qiuling said, she took out a few big white steamed buns from her arms, they were still steaming and still smelled of her.
"Qiu Ling, you are so kind."
Li Dapao was a little moved. When Ye Qiuling first married into their village, he had been thinking about her day and night.
Now that everything he wished could come true, and it had developed to this point, he just felt like he was dreaming.
"Silly boy, if I am not good to you, who will be good to you?"
Ye Qiuling smiled and said that after becoming Li Dapao's woman, her attitude towards him has obviously changed dramatically.
"Uh-huh!"
Meng Wanqing was interrupting from the side, and she felt that if she didn't stop them, these two people would dare to act recklessly in front of her.
She was a little surprised. She didn't expect that there was such a handsome woman in Niuduzi Village.
That is, not dressed up.
If she dresses up, she will not be inferior to her.
"Ah? Cannon, do you have a woman in your family?"
Only then did Ye Qiuling discover Meng Wanqing. She was also amazed by her beauty, and then she felt jealous in her heart.
"Hello, I am the new village party secretary in Niuduzi Village. I have no place to stay for the time being, so I am staying at Comrade Li Dapao's house temporarily." Meng Wanqing explained again.
"That's it, I, I have something else to do, I'll leave first."
Ye Qiuling left quickly, fearing that others would see something.
"The steamed buns made by Qiu Ling, and the eggs cooked by Aunt Wang."
Li Dapao only felt that his life had reached its peak and he could compete with Cao Mengde.
"Li Dapao, the people in your village are really simple and honest. They deliver eggs and steamed buns. Will someone come to deliver milk to you later?"
Meng Wanqing spat, she felt that Li Dapao and Ye Qiuling must have had an affair, and there must be some unknown secret.
"Oh, Miss Meng, you are right. I was a pretty young man in the village. He gave me a lot of food."
Li Dapao opened his mouth to fool, but he was not joking. After a while, another lady came over to bring him food.
Meng Wanqing had no doubts this time, because the aunt in front of her was very old and had lost two of her teeth, so she couldn't doubt that there was an affair between them.
“Cannon, he’s promising and looking for a wife.
"Auntie, don't get me wrong, I'm not his wife. "
"I understand, young people now like to call themselves girlfriends. "
The aunt put on an air of understanding, and then left immediately, so as not to affect the young couple's love affair.
Meng Wanqing couldn't sit still, and immediately went out with Li Dapao. She wanted to summon the whole village to make an announcement, so as not to have to explain to each person.
“Cannon, please shout for me and call all the people in the village. "
Meng Wanqing said that she could now see the general appearance of the village clearly.
Niuduzi Village has a famous name, but the village is not big and the houses are all dilapidated. At first glance, it looks very poor and backward.
Li Dapao was very cooperative and shouted at the top of his lungs: "Everyone has come over for a meeting, and they are still hugging their own wives on the kang, or hugging other people's wives and being reluctant to get up. After the meeting, they go back and continue to lie down. "
The village is not big, but his voice called all the villagers in the village over.
